name: The Hanged Man
meaning_for_today: Today may require patience, reflection, and a different perspective. Do not rush important decisions. A pause can help reveal hidden truths and deeper understanding.
card_advice: Let go of control and allow events to unfold naturally. Sometimes sacrifice, patience, and changing your viewpoint are necessary for growth and wisdom.

upright.short: Pause, sacrifice, reflection, surrender, new perspective.
upright.general: The Hanged Man symbolizes suspension, inner transformation, patience, and seeing life differently. This card often appears when circumstances force a pause or require personal sacrifice. It encourages spiritual growth, acceptance, and letting go of outdated beliefs.
upright.in_love: In relationships, The Hanged Man suggests waiting, emotional reflection, or reevaluating feelings. It may indicate a period of uncertainty or the need to understand a partner from a new perspective.
upright.in_situation: The situation is temporarily paused or developing slowly. Rushing will not help now. Reflection, acceptance, and openness to a new viewpoint are required before progress becomes possible.

reversed.general: Reversed, The Hanged Man may indicate resistance to change, unnecessary sacrifice, stubbornness, or feeling trapped in stagnation. It can suggest fear of letting go or refusal to accept reality.
reversed.in_love: In love readings, the reversed Hanged Man may point to emotional confusion, delays in relationships, or unwillingness to compromise. One or both partners may avoid necessary changes.
reversed.in_situation: The situation may feel blocked due to indecision or resistance. The card advises releasing control, accepting necessary changes, and avoiding self-imposed limitations.
